content.short: Soren ID is a Web3 app on TON that blends street fashion culture with rewarding social gaming.
content.description: Soren ID is an innovative SocialFi application built on the TON blockchain that targets the intersection of digital identity, street fashion, and gaming. It provides users with a platform to express their style through unique digital assets and participate in a gamified ecosystem powered by the $SOR token. Soren ID emphasizes community engagement and cultural expression, leveraging the social connectivity of Telegram to create a rewarding environment for fashion-forward Web3 enthusiasts. It represents a new trend of niche social applications flourishing on the TON network.
content.meta: Express your style and earn with Soren ID on TON. Where fashion meets Web3 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
